name: dendrop
description: Private, self-hosted chat for family and friends: direct messages, calls and chat servers.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/shared packages/server && npm run build -w @dendrop/web
scripts.test: tsc -b packages/shared packages/server && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test "packages/server/dist/test/**/*.test.js" "packages/theme/test/*.test.ts" && npm test -w @dendrop/desktop
